outcome_access_before_amendment: none: no 8-K submissions row, price, return, S/Q value or exhibit was read; the audit has never run
trigger: Automated Codex review of pull request shifosss/frontier-trading-agent#2, six P2 findings on commit 5cbf8a2a

changes.reason: The reused capture and features modules executed at import before their digests were checked. audit.py now hard-codes their SHA256 and executes only the verified bytes.

changes.field: runtime; inputs gain pyproject.toml and uv.lock
changes.reason: Dependency identity was not bound. Python 3.13 is required, the project/lock files are bound, and each attempt records exact Python, platform, SQLite, tzdata and zoneinfo TZPATH plus every input identity.
Unique Item 2.02 and empty-primary-document counts read only the first variant of a conflicting accession, so they depended on source order. Conflicts are now excluded and listed separately.

Bound per-issuer discovery/root files were global required inputs, so one unrestorable issuer file blocked the whole audit, contradicting the per-issuer unavailability rule. Absent per-issuer inputs now make only that issuer unavailable; changed bytes stay fatal; the input state must be identical at start and end.
late_10q_beyond_window was null for unavailable issuers. It is now computed from every frozen manifest.
Amendment records listed in freeze.json were not re-verified at run time. Every record must now exist, match its digest and match the definition's amendment list.

unchanged: Denominators, window, candidate form/token, clock function, ambiguity/coverage classification, locks, bounds and verdict thresholds.
